author: n70
body:
I am sorry FrostedCupecakez for supporting that horrendous cheater. It was a joke and first and I thought you thought that too. But I've learned that I should never do that anymore and I am sorry, sorry for all the things I've done. I don't know who he/she is, but I have to admit that I felt bad. Really bad. I've spent 150 USD on this server (Dia rank for iiOmega, _Isa, and myself) I do not want that money to go to waste and I beg of you to try to unban me. I promise to NOT do anything like this again and if I do you shall punish me as you please.

Sorry, xoxo 

-Pixel

title: Appeal.

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Greetings, _Kimmy.

Unfortunately for you, our policy strictly dictates that ban evasion punishments are non-negotiable and will not be appealed under any circumstances other than ones where the infraction is proven to be invalid, thus appealed and removed. This is not the case though, so you will remain banned and you are not expected to appeal again.

Sincerely,
- timaeusTestified | Senior Moderator
